status: parameters fixed before CRISPResso2 outputs; retrospective sources and earlier observer results known
question: Compare an unmodified external alignment engine with existing anchor observers at a matched finite raw denominator and a matched molecular event. Native modified statistics retained separately.
scope: nine unique primary CFB streams PE/mock/untreated; no trims; primary PE-mock and secondary PE-untreated; no new biological units
quality: External exact prefilter arithmetic mean Phred+33 over original entire raw read >=30. Excluded reads stay U within raw N. CRISPResso quality options zero; no trimming or N replacement.

alignment.reference: single modal observed untreated full-read reference; see REFERENCE.json

adapter: Project aligned observed bases over reference core and first two right-motif bases. Include insertions between coding reference positions; insertion at left boundary included if after reference position start-1. Require observed ACGT bases at immediately flanking reference positions start-1 and coding_end_exclusive; all projected coding bases ACGT. Internal deletion columns omitted; end coverage/ambiguous bases =>U. No imputation of reference bases. Native event translates projected coding, full programmed event equals exact programmed core plus first two right-motif bases.
comparisons: All original raw read IDs; gate failures/not aligned/insufficient coverage remain U; E<->NE conflicts retained and investigated, not silently united. Full intervals exact Fraction.
limitations: Reference chosen retrospectively from one observed control; no reference-free truth.
Native modified frequency and native local peptide are different estimands.
External pipeline agreement is computational concordance, not truth calibration.
No independent dataset, biological efficacy or population generalization.
Any adapter changes after results must be separate named sensitivity with reason and preserved original output.
